description: Look up private US companies on SEC EDGAR by legal name or CIK and return their funding history: one company row (offerings on file, total and largest Form D amount sold, first and latest filing, executives) plus one row per Form D private placement or Form C crowdfunding offering (amount offered and sold, first sale date, security types such as equity or SAFE, investor count, crowdfunding platform, filing link). Primary SEC filings only; rounds raised outside Regulation D and Regulation CF are not on EDGAR.

companies.description: One company per item: its legal name as filed with the SEC (Ramp Business Corp, Commure, Inc.) or its SEC CIK (1803782). Legal suffixes such as Inc or LLC can be left off. As text, put one company per line; commas inside a name are kept.

filed_after.description: Optional. Keep offerings with a filing on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD or a year such as 2022.

forms.description: both (default): Form D private placements and Form C crowdfunding offerings. d: Form D only. c: Form C only.

match.description: exact (default): the EDGAR name must equal your name once legal suffixes are removed. starts_with: if there is no exact match, take the most viewed EDGAR name that starts with your name and is not a fund, SPV, or series. Check entity_name on the row.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Rows already charged are kept.

max_rounds_per_company.description: Newest offerings first, 1 to 200. Default 50. The company row counts every offering on file.

name: get_company_funding_history
title: Get private company funding history
